_comment: A storewide sale: percentOff off every product (not shipping) from starts
until ends. Both times are Swiss time; ends is the first moment the sale is
over, so 2026-12-01T00:00:00+01:00 means it runs through November 30.
Everything reads this file, and everything stops on its own at ends:
- the checkout Worker only attaches the Stripe coupon before ends,
- the shop pages check the visitor's clock and show regular prices after,
- the Merchant Center feed sends sale_price with this effective date,
- deploy.yml rebuilds the site every night just after midnight Swiss
time, so the static HTML and the product structured data follow.
To run a new sale: change the dates, percentOff, name and coupon (a new
coupon id, Stripe coupons cannot be edited), then:
To have no sale, set percentOff to 0.
name: Black Friday
